sections.value: Final round of #252 at cf816e679aac24e42a9e2d96d27de906bcb7fc61 closes the prior one-glyph brake gap: column-zero one-of ∙ ∘ ● ◉ ◎ ○, space, nonblank text, in the two rows immediately before the composer box. Indented transcript bullets do not match. Exact-head JUnit artifact14494890500 records all32 composer tests passing, including all six frames, idle, indented bullet and the live-derived draft at caret13/Home. The new draft footer drops sidebar hints, so that fixture refuses rather than reading a clipped draft. Three read-only actual idle snapshots (panes %189, %188, %186 at 2026-11-19T03:02:04.976Z) had a blank row and cwd immediately above the box and empty content: no blanket idle brake match. No local classifier test, pane input or daemon bounce. No C21 disclosure in the complete new draft fixture/docs delta. Preexisting context-footer draft+Home prefix clipping remains a C34 follow-up, not a blocker of this final-round fix. Magic wand: spinner vocabulary provenance and evidence-bearing clean delegated reports should be deterministic harness inputs; never infer all animation states from one frame.
